/api/reference/metrics.name: Bookings vs target
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Sum of TCV moved to Closed Won with close date in period, divided by the bookings target for the period. Status compares bookings with plan pace.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: bookings = SUM(tcv_usd) WHERE stage = Closed Won AND close_date IN period; attainment vs pace = bookings / plan pace (target pro-rated to today).
/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: At or above plan pace (On track ≥97% of pace; Watch 85–97%)

/api/reference/metrics.name: Pipeline coverage
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Qualified open pipeline (Qualify or later) with expected close in the current and next quarter, divided by the combined target for those two quarters less bookings already achieved in them.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(tcv_usd) open Qualify+ closing in current/next quarter ÷ (target(current) + target(next) − bookings(current, next)).

/api/reference/metrics.name: Win rate
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Count of Closed Won divided by count of Closed Won plus Closed Lost, for opportunities closed in period. Value variant uses TCV. No-bid and client-cancelled excluded.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: COUNT(won) ÷ (COUNT(won) + COUNT(lost)) for close_date IN period.

/api/reference/metrics.name: New pipeline created
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Sum of TCV of opportunities with created date in period, regardless of later outcome. Goal: three times the bookings target for the period, pro-rated for the current quarter.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(tcv_usd) WHERE created_date IN period ÷ (3 × plan-pace target for period).

/api/reference/metrics.name: Offering-led pipeline share
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open TCV where Offering is not Capability-led, divided by total open TCV. Untagged opportunities are shown as a separate bucket and count against the share.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(open tcv_usd WHERE offering_class = Offering-led) ÷ SUM(open tcv_usd).

/api/reference/metrics.name: Average deal cycle
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Mean of (close date minus created date) in days for Closed Won in period.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: AVG(close_date − created_date) WHERE stage = Closed Won AND close_date IN period.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Bookings runway
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Booked FY TCV; Commit = sum of TCV × stage probability for open deals in Orals or Negotiate closing this quarter; Best case = same for Qualify and Propose; full-year target; plan pace.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: booked = SUM(won tcv_usd in FY); commit/best case = SUM(tcv_usd × standard stage probability) closing in current quarter; plan pace = completed quarter targets + current quarter target × elapsed share (calendar days).

/api/reference/metrics.name: Bookings by quarter
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Closed-won TCV per fiscal quarter with quarterly target.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(won tcv_usd) GROUP BY close quarter, joined to quarterly target.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Open pipeline by vertical
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open TCV by account vertical, split Qualify-or-later versus Identify.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(open tcv_usd) GROUP BY vertical, qualified (Qualify+) vs Identify.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Deals needing attention
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open opportunities with TCV at or above threshold (default $2M) and days in current stage over 60 (Ageing) or over 90 (Stalled). Days in stage = today minus date the current stage was entered.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: open AND tcv_usd ≥ threshold AND days_in_stage > 60; flag Ageing (61–90) / Stalled (>90). Past-dated open deals (DQ-02) are also listed.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Stage funnel and conversion
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open opportunities (count and TCV) at each stage, with stage-to-stage conversion: opportunities that reached the next stage divided by those that reached this stage, for opportunities created in the trailing four quarters.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: reached(s) = COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity with a stage-history row at s); conversion(s → s+1) = reached(s+1) ÷ reached(s); trailing 4 quarters by created date.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Pipeline ageing
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open opportunities by stage and days in current stage bucket (0–30 / 31–60 / 61–90 / over 90). Over 90 days is Stalled. Buckets are admin-configurable.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: days_in_stage = today − date the current stage was entered; COUNT and SUM(tcv_usd) per stage × ref_bucket.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Pipeline by practice
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open TCV by practice, from opportunity line items, split into the opportunity's lead practice and contributing practices.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(line-item amount in USD) of open opportunities GROUP BY practice, lead vs contributing.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Pipeline by platform
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open TCV by primary technology platform, split Qualify-or-later versus Identify.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(open tcv_usd) GROUP BY primary_platform, qualified (Qualify+) vs Identify.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Deal-size distribution
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open opportunities (count and TCV) by deal-size band. Bands are admin-configurable.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: COUNT and SUM(tcv_usd) of open opportunities per ref_size_band.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Opportunity register
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Every open opportunity within the caller's scope, sortable, searchable and exportable; ageing and stalled deals carry a text flag.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: open opportunities; flag = Ageing (61–90 days in stage) / Stalled (over 90) / Past close date.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Week-over-week stage movement
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Change in open pipeline between the two latest weekly snapshots: created, advanced, regressed, slipped (same stage, close date passed or moved out) and closed.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: Compare fact_opportunity_snapshot at the latest and previous Monday per opportunity; classify by stage order and close date.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Win rate by quarter
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Closed Won deals divided by Closed Won plus Closed Lost, by close quarter over the last eight quarters. No-bid and client-cancelled deals are excluded. The headline is the trailing four quarters.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(won) / count(won + lost) grouped by close quarter; a value-weighted variant divides won TCV by decided TCV.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Loss reasons
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Closed Lost deals over the last four quarters by the loss reason recorded in CRM; deals with no reason are shown as Not recorded. The share is of all lost deals.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(lost) grouped by coalesce(loss_reason, 'Not recorded'); the most frequent recorded reason is highlighted.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Win rate by deal source
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Win rate and share of decided deals by deal source (Client RFP, Proactive, Partner-sourced, Campaign / Marketing, Account expansion) over the last four quarters.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(won) / count(won + lost) grouped by lead source.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Bid discipline
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Of RFPs that reached the bid/no-bid gate in the last four quarters: the no-bid rate, the win rate of pursued RFPs, and the share submitted within SLA. A callout fires when both the no-bid rate and the pursued win rate are below target.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: no-bid = count(decision = no_bid) / count(RFPs); pursued win rate = won / (won + lost) among bid decisions; on-time = submitted on or before received + SLA days.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Orals conversion
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Of pursuits that reached orals, the share that were won (Won divided by Won plus Lost); deals still open are shown separately.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(won) / count(won + lost) among pursuits flagged orals_reached.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Margin at bid vs delivery
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Margin priced into the final bid compared with the margin realised in delivery, for won deals that have been delivering for at least a quarter. Restricted to GTM Lead, Leadership and Finance.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: erosion = TCV-weighted (bid margin − delivery margin) over won deals with project financials; shown by close quarter.
/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: Delivery margin within 3 points of bid margin

/api/reference/metrics.name: Pipeline and wins by offering
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open pipeline and closed-won TCV per offering. Capability-led deals are a separate bucket and untagged deals are shown apart, counted against the offering-led share.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(tcv_usd) by offering for open deals and for Closed Won deals closed in the period; offering-led share = offering-tagged TCV ÷ all TCV.
/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: Offering-led share of pipeline and wins

/api/reference/metrics.name: Attach rate and practices per deal
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Share of Closed Won deals that include more than one practice, plus the distribution of practices per deal.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(won deals with ≥2 practice line items) ÷ count(won deals) in the period.

/api/reference/metrics.name: AI-led validation split
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open pipeline TCV split into AI-led and validated, AI-led and not validated, and not AI-led. The unvalidated AI-led value is called out with the largest deals.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(tcv_usd) of open deals by validation state; validated = AI-led with a Validated record in the AI validation register matching the deal's validation ID.

sources.name: AI validation register (SharePoint List via Microsoft Graph / M365 MCP)

/api/reference/metrics.name: Asset reuse
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Uses of each knowledge asset in proposals over the last 12 months. Assets with fewer than 8 uses are flagged low reuse; assets not refreshed for over 180 days are flagged refresh due.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(proposal asset uses in the last 12 months) per asset; flags use the low-reuse and refresh-due settings.

sources.name: Knowledge repository (SharePoint via Microsoft Graph / M365 MCP)

/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: Assets with enough reuse and a recent refresh

/api/reference/metrics.name: Demos, accelerators and solutions developed
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Assets released this fiscal year against the build plan pace, with items in development by target quarter, the share of released assets used in a pursuit, and mean build time in weeks. Items missing an Asset ID or type are excluded (DQ-09).
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: released ÷ plan pace (planned releases of completed quarters plus the current quarter pro-rated); reuse = released assets used in a proposal ÷ released assets.

sources.name: Knowledge repository (SharePoint via Microsoft Graph / M365 MCP)

/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: At or above build plan pace (On track ≥90% of pace)

/api/reference/metrics.name: Practice penetration matrix
/api/reference/metrics.definition: For each account and practice: Sold (a Closed Won deal this fiscal year includes the practice), Open (an open deal includes it) or Not addressed.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: state from practice line items of this fiscal year's Closed Won and open deals.
/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: More practices sold or pursued per account

/api/reference/metrics.name: Whitespace pursued
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Share of whitespace (practices not yet sold) that is being pursued through an open deal.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: Open cells ÷ (Open cells + Not addressed cells) across accounts in scope.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Expansion vs new logo
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Closed Won TCV split between existing accounts (a booking in the 24 months before close) and new logos.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(tcv_usd) of Closed Won deals in the period; expansion when the account has booking history in the 24 months before the close date.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Account-plan health
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Strategic accounts by plan status: Current (reviewed within 90 days), Needs update (91–120 days) or Overdue (over 120 days or no plan).
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: days since last_review_date, banded by the account-plan health settings.

sources.name: Account plans (CRM object or SharePoint via M365 MCP)

/api/reference/metrics.name: Pipeline by partner
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open pipeline TCV tagged to a partner, split between deals the partner sourced and deals it influenced.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(tcv_usd) of open deals by partner and partner role (Sourced / Influenced).

sources.name: Partner portals (Adobe, Salesforce partner APIs / monthly export)

/api/reference/metrics.name: Co-sell performance
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Win rate of deals with a partner against deals without one, and the share of bookings with partner involvement.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: won ÷ (won + lost) for deals with and without a partner in the period; partner share = won TCV with a partner ÷ all won TCV.

sources.name: Partner portals (Adobe, Salesforce partner APIs / monthly export)

/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: Win rate with partner above win rate without

/api/reference/metrics.name: Certification status
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Active partner certifications held by Moment people against the number required for each partner tier, with learners still in progress in the LMS.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(unexpired certifications) ÷ required certifications, per partner.

sources.name: Partner portals (Adobe, Salesforce partner APIs / monthly export)

/api/reference/metrics.name: Architect load
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Open pursuits per Solution Architect. An architect is the person holding the Solution Architect role on an open deal at Qualify, Propose or Orals. Healthy is up to 3, stretched is 4 and over capacity is 5 or more.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(open deals at Qualify/Propose/Orals) per Solution Architect on the opportunity team; banded from the CAP-01 thresholds.
/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: No architect over capacity (healthy up to 3 open pursuits)

/api/reference/metrics.name: RFP turnaround and SLA
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Days from RFP received to proposal submitted, and the share of submissions inside the SLA agreed for that RFP, by quarter of submission.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: avg(submitted − received) and count(submitted ≤ received + SLA) ÷ count(submitted).

/api/reference/metrics.name: Cost of sale
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Pursuit effort priced at the finance cost rate, as a share of the TCV of the pursuits it was spent on (won and lost). Restricted to GTM Lead, Leadership and Finance.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(timesheet hours × role cost rate) ÷ SUM(TCV) over pursuits decided in the last four quarters.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Proposal quality score
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Average gate-review quality score (1 to 5) of pursued proposals, compared for won and lost deals.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: avg(quality_score) by outcome over pursued deals decided in the last four quarters.
/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: Won proposals score higher than lost ones

/api/reference/metrics.name: Thought leadership volume & reach
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Count of published POVs and major thought-leadership assets per quarter, alongside engagement (downloads and engaged visits).
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: count(assets) WHERE published_date IN quarter; sum(downloads), sum(engaged_visits).

/api/reference/metrics.name: Discovery workshop conversion
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Conversion of client discovery workshops into opportunities created within 90 days, qualified opportunities and wins.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: workshops held -> opportunities created within 90 days -> qualified -> won; conversion rate = qualified / workshops held.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Campaign-sourced pipeline
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Pipeline TCV created in the period where a campaign is the primary source, by campaign and quarter.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: SUM(tcv_usd) WHERE campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND primary_source = TRUE AND created_date IN period.

/api/reference/metrics.name: Analyst positioning
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Placement and direction of travel in major analyst evaluations (Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant, IDC MarketScape, Everest Group PEAK Matrix).
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: Current placement vs prior evaluation placement, with direction icon and text (↑ Improved, → Maintained, ↓ Declined).

sources.name: Analyst relations register (SharePoint List via M365 MCP)

/api/reference/metrics.goal_label: Leader / Strong Performer with positive or stable trajectory

/api/reference/metrics.name: Mandatory-field completeness
/api/reference/metrics.definition: Share of qualified opportunities (Qualify or later) that have an offering tag, lead practice, primary platform, deal source and owner.
/api/reference/metrics.calculation: complete / qualified per ISO week; go-live gate is 95% for two consecutive weeks.
